title: John Dalton and the Rise of Modern Chemistry
lineage: This edition’s title page says 1896. Roscoe retrospectively reports that Thomson taught the theory publicly at once after the 1804 meeting; exact lecture dates, locations, audience and source lineage are not independently established.
